title: Building Ethical AI Governance
summary: Experts emphasize the importance of transparency, diversity, and inclusivity in developing ethical frameworks for AI governance. They highlight the need to adapt existing systems and policies to address the unique challenges posed by AI. Collaboration among stakeholders is crucial to ensure that AI benefits society as a whole.

patterns.statement: The development of AI ethics and governance requires a multi-stakeholder approach, involving diverse perspectives and expertise.
Existing systems and policies may need to be adapted or transformed to address the unique challenges posed by AI.

contrasts.statement: There is a tension between anchoring AI governance to existing accepted norms and creating new frameworks that challenge these norms.
